title: Normalize history flags after overlap reconciliation completes a transcript
outcome: Preserve-head reconciliation can merge a resident prefix with an incoming tail into a complete 0..messageCount window while independently retaining hasOlderHistory or hasNewerHistory from a partial response. The UI can then report messagesLoaded=true yet continue requesting history. Normalize both flags when the merged resident window is complete and add an overlapping-window regression.
acceptance: When reconciliation produces a complete transcript window, messagesLoaded is true and both history-availability flags are false. Focused tests cover resident-prefix plus incoming-tail completion and prevent redundant history demand.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect2 batch 10f6b1ad, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. A complete merged transcript forces loaded=true and both availability flags false (ui/src/session-reconcile.ts:511,543,549), with the exact overlap regression at session-reconcile.test.ts:2591. Closed by evidence.
